audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Zac levels 2 and 3 and only Skill at 6, while the whys say W at 2 already turns trades into healing wins, level 3 is a 'true rotation', and the level 6 Hijack makes the all-in math 'overwhelming'. The mirror audit (zac vs sylas) has already settled this chart.
audit.why: I am restating the mirror's finding from this side rather than re-deriving it: Sylas keeps levels 1-2 and level 6, levels 3 and 4-5 are Skill, and Zac takes first item and two items. Note this is not the packet chart, which lists Sylas on all seven rows — I followed the mirror so the two pages cannot contradict.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Sylas, Sylas, Skill, Skill, Sylas, Zac, Zac in both layers; ratings adjusted on the rows that moved.

audit.why: Four spikes: level 2-3 kit completion, level 6 Hijack, Riftmaker, and Zac's own level 6 disengage. All four are real and correctly timed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three gaps and one error. The error: the early text says E2 'chains him in place' — Sylas's E recast pulls him to the target and has no CC. The gaps: Cell Division's revive is never mentioned (the page calls it only 'blob passive regen'); Unstable Matter is absent entirely despite being a 5-second cooldown that deals a percentage of your maximum health; and Elastic Slingshot's cooldown is quoted as fifteen seconds when it is 21/18/15/12/9.
audit.why: The revive is the decisive fact: a Sylas who correctly counts lethal, commits everything and kills Zac can still lose the fight when he reforms from surviving bloblets. Unstable Matter is why standing next to him in an extended brawl is worse than the page implies, and no amount of armour changes it.
audit.corrected: Revive and Grievous Wounds written into the early text and wants.foe[1]; Unstable Matter's 5-second percent-max-health pulse written into whys[3]; Slingshot stated at 21 seconds; the 'lock him in place' claim replaced with what E2 actually does.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames are false positives, as the mirror audit already established: the text reads "Let's Bounce!" and the tokenizer dropped the exclamation mark, and 'Elastic Slingshot' is correct in both places it was flagged.

edits.before: Q Chain Lash is your only level-1 tool and Zac's blob passive regen absorbs small hits — poke his step-ups but don't burn E chasing.
edits.after: Q Chain Lash is your only level-1 tool and Zac reabsorbs blobs to heal the chip back — poke his step-ups but never burn E chasing.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot punishes you if it lands, but its cooldown window is your aggression cue — weave passive chain-autos and trade every time it's down.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21 seconds at rank 1 and that downtime is your aggression cue — but Unstable Matter still pulses percent max HP every 5s up close.

edits.before: Level 1 is quiet — your Q is your only tool and Zac's passive blobs regen chip damage, so poke his step-ups with Chain Lash but never chase. The real game starts at level 2: W online means even trades heal you back, and Zac has no escape from a committed E2-chain-into-W burst. By level 3 your full rotation — E1 shield through his Q or basic, E2 chain to lock him in place, Q slow so he can't walk, W lunge for the burst-heal — out-damages and out-sustains everything he can throw. Keep an eye on Elastic Slingshot's charge animation and never step up into it; punish its cooldown window instead.
edits.after: Level 1 is quiet — your Q is your only tool and Zac reabsorbs his blobs to heal the chip back, so poke his step-ups with Chain Lash but never chase. The real game starts at level 2: W online means even trades heal you back, and Zac has no escape from a committed E2-into-W burst. By level 3 your full rotation — E1 in, E2 to pull yourself onto him, Q slow so he can't walk, W lunge for the burst-heal — out-damages everything he can throw. Buy Grievous Wounds before you plan a kill: fatal damage splits him into four bloblets and he revives if any survive. Punish the Slingshot's 21-second cooldown rather than stepping into its charge.

edits.before: Blob sustain through your poke with passive cell regeneration, delaying the kill window until he has enough HP to survive a full rotation
edits.after: Reabsorb his blobs through your poke, then bank on the bloblet revive so the kill you counted as lethal simply does not stick

edits.before: Zac burns Elastic Slingshot on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Zac burns Elastic Slingshot on nothing — take the twenty-one-second invitation.

notes: Mirror reused: the level chart follows the already-audited zac vs sylas page (Sylas 1-2 and 6, Skill 3 and 4-5, Zac first item and two items) rather than the packet chart, which lists Sylas on all seven rows — flagging the packet/mirror disagreement rather than fighting the mirror. The kit file carries a 'grounding' flag on Zac's E, which would matter enormously to Sylas (both his W and E are dashes), but Riot's description of Elastic Slingshot mentions no grounding at all — per the instruction to trust the description over a misfiring derived flag I did not write it, and it is listed in unverified. The bloblet revive on Cell Division was the biggest omission on this page.
